ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Actuarial Sciene, College of Business Majors and Curriculum Unassigned. On Monday, November 14, registration will be opened to Agri-Accounting, Finance in Agribusiness, Agri-Finance, Consumer Economics and Finance majors, and Technology and Management minors. On Monday, November 21, registration will be opened to Business Minors. Students from other programs should contact finregistration@business.illinois.edu on or after January 1, 2017.
